## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the reason for the change.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant local tests pass
- [ ] Required GitHub Actions checks pass on this exact head commit
- [ ] Real-device validation is complete, or this pull request remains a draft
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior or architecture changed
- [ ] No generated artifacts, credentials, or local agent files are included
- [ ] The head branch can be deleted after merge or closure
